structured.feedback: The description is about 210 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the slipping and color-swap complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are that "many shoppers say" overstates a single review, and the feature/benefit split is a little loose.
